positive.prompt: Is billing-api ready to go to production?
Can we promote this to uat? Walk the release checklist
What is the state of the release session for billing-api in qa?

negative.prompt: Write the launch plan with a canary and rollback thresholds
Verify the canary is healthy after the deploy

evals.prompt: Is this ready to release to uat? The platform output and checklist are attached.
evals.expected_output: Each checklist item marked verified with evidence, not verified with who can confirm it, or failed
expectations: Marks the build and source-environment health items verified and cites the pasted output
Marks items with no evidence, such as migration rollback tested and on-call awareness, not verified and says who can confirm
Notes that no test results were published and does not call tests passing
Flags that the runbook has not changed although a new export feature ships
Ends with a plain recommendation and the list of things a human must confirm
Points to opening the release in the portal's Deliver tab and does not start, approve or roll back anything
Runs no kubectl, argocd or gcloud command

evals.prompt: Is this ready to release to uat? The platform MCP server is not connected, so you only have the repository.
evals.expected_output: Platform-dependent items reported not verified, with no fallback to cluster commands
expectations: Says the platform server is not connected and marks build, health and alert items not verified
Does not substitute kubectl, argocd or gcloud commands
Still reports what the repository shows, such as the migration and the feature flag default
